brief:
Alaa lives in a tent on the rubble of her home, destroyed in an Israeli airstrike that killed all three of her children, The Guardian reported. She is pregnant and due to give birth within a month, facing the prospect of delivering her baby amid ongoing conflict and displacement.

The account captures the daily reality for Palestinians navigating pregnancy and motherhood under conditions of war, loss, and displacement in Gaza. Alaa's situation reflects the broader humanitarian crisis affecting civilians in the territory.
dek: Alaa lives in a tent pitched on the ruins of her house, which was destroyed by an Israeli airstrike that killed all three of her children. In one month, she will give birth again.
title: Pregnant Gaza woman faces childbirth after losing three children to airstrike
